description: Index of available MCP servers for query routing. Fed to mcp_router.py's single routing call along with the live tool schemas from mcp_tools_cache.json. Each server's 'description' and 'disambiguation' exist to separate it from servers it could plausibly be confused with -- keep both current whenever server scope changes.

servers.description: Read and manage GitHub repositories: issues, pull requests, commits, code search, branches, releases, and repo metadata. Acts on real GitHub data via an authenticated account.
servers.disambiguation: Use only when the query references an actual repo, PR, issue, or GitHub account action. Do NOT use for the model writing/explaining code from scratch -- that's plain chat, no tool needed.

servers.description: Search YouTube and fetch video metadata, transcripts/captions, and channel info. Does NOT play audio/video locally -- read-only lookups only.
servers.disambiguation: Use when the user wants INFORMATION about a video/channel (transcript, summary, who made it, how many views) -- not when they want something played out loud. 'What's that video about' -> youtube_mcp. 'Play that video/song' -> music_mcp.

servers.description: Controls actual local/connected playback -- starts, pauses, resumes, or stops audio/video, including pulling from YouTube as a playback source.
servers.disambiguation: Use whenever the user wants something to actually START PLAYING (song, video, audio) regardless of source platform named -- 'play X on youtube' still means music_mcp, since youtube_mcp cannot play anything. 'Play', 'pause', 'stop', 'skip', 'resume' are the trigger verbs.

servers.description: Searches the open web and fetches page content for current events, facts, or research not covered by any other server here.
servers.disambiguation: Use for general/current-events questions. If the query is specifically about a YouTube video or GitHub repo, prefer those servers instead -- they're more precise for their domain.

servers.description: Generates, edits, or analyzes images -- text-to-image creation, image editing, and describing/inspecting uploaded images.
Stores, retrieves, and searches persistent memories/notes about the user for long-term recall across sessions.
servers.disambiguation: Use only when the user explicitly asks to remember/recall a fact long-term. Do NOT use for referencing something said earlier in THIS conversation -- that's already in context, no tool needed.

servers.description: Sends and reads messages on the user's behalf -- email, SMS, chat, or notifications.
Astrology and astronomy lookups: horoscopes, birth charts, planetary positions, celestial events.
